programs.name: Post Graduate Programme in Management - PGP (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Batch 2026-28 (INR 11,75,000 per year); same for PGP, PGP-Finance and PGP-LSM. Caution deposit, welfare fund and mess deposit extra.

feeSource.title: IIM Kozhikode - Fee Structure (PGP, PGP-Finance and PGP-LSM), Batch 2026-28
feeSource.quote: FEE STRUCTURE (PGP, PGP-Finance and PGP-LSM) ... Total: First Year (2026-2027) ₹11,75,000; Second Year (2027-28) ₹11,75,000 [Tuition 7,00,000 per year; includes Admission, IT/Infrastructure, Library, Hostel, Books & Study Material, Student Activities, etc.]. In addition to the above, an amount of ₹25,000/- towards the Caution Deposit ... and ₹2,000/- towards the Students' Welfare Fund ... ₹40,000/- shall be payable towards mess and students' activities deposit

programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2025 sanctioned intake (academic year 2023-24) for all 2-year PG programmes of the institute combined, not only this programme.
